hook: PTP: previous-token prediction for black-box LLM prompt reconstruction
hookText: PTP: previous-token prediction for black-box LLM prompt reconstruction

beats.say: A paper trains an inverse language model from scratch, using previous-token prediction on data generated by the target LLM, to reconstruct prompts from responses without weights or logits.
Prior LLM inversion work treats prompt recovery as semantic reconstruction, fine-tuning seq2seq models on large external datasets and often needing weights or logits.
PTP instead mirrors next-token prediction: the inverse model learns to generate the prompt backwards from the response, trained only on synthetic prompt/response pairs from the target model.
